homePage.title: OpenDiscourse Platform Overview
homePage.content:
Welcome to the OpenDiscourse Legislative Data Platform documentation space. This comprehensive guide covers the platform architecture, development processes, and integration with multiple project management tools.

## Platform Architecture

OpenDiscourse is a sophisticated legislative data processing platform that ingests, processes, and serves data from multiple sources:

- **Congress Data**: Comprehensive congressional bill and member information
- **OpenStates Data**: State-level legislative data from multiple states
- **GovInfo Data**: Official government information and documents
- **Semantic Search**: AI-powered document similarity and search capabilities

## Development Workflow

Our development process integrates with multiple project management platforms:

- **GitHub**: Code repository, issues, and CI/CD workflows
- **Linear**: Sprint planning and team collaboration
- **GitLab**: Epic management and milestone tracking
- **Bitbucket**: Pipeline automation and code quality
- **Jira**: Agile development and issue tracking
- **Confluence**: Technical documentation and knowledge sharing

## Getting Started

1. **Development Setup**: See [Development Environment Setup](https://opendiscourse.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/OD/pages/Development+Environment+Setup)
2. **Architecture Overview**: Review [System Architecture](https://opendiscourse.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/OD/pages/System+Architecture)
3. **Data Flow**: Understand [Ingestion Workflows](https://opendiscourse.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/OD/pages/Ingestion+Workflows)
4. **Project Status**: Check [Current Sprint Status](https://opendiscourse.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/OD/pages/Current+Sprint+Status)

## Platform Links

- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/cbwinslow/opendiscourse)

- [Bitbucket Repositories](https://bitbucket.org/cbwinslow/opendiscourse/)

## Project Vision

### 🎯 Semantic Search Engine
- PGVector integration for vector similarity search
- AI-powered document embeddings
- Contextual search beyond keyword matching
- Intelligent result ranking

### 🧠 AI-Powered Insights

- Legislative trend analysis
- Policy relationship discovery
- Automated document summarization

### 📈 Historical Data Expansion
- Complete Congress history spanning decades
- Roll call vote analysis
- Committee activity tracking
- Amendment evolution mapping

pages.content:
# OpenDiscourse System Architecture

## High-Level Architecture

The OpenDiscourse platform is built with a microservices architecture optimized for data ingestion, processing, and serving legislative information.

## Core Components

### 🔄 Data Ingestion Layer

**Congress API Integration**
- [GitHub Issue #1](https://github.com/cbwinslow/opendiscourse/issues/1): Fix chamber mapping foreign key constraint
- [Linear Task CONG-101](https://linear.app/opendiscourse/task/CONG-101): Implement chamber validation
- [GitLab Issue #1](https://gitlab.com/cbwinslow/opendiscourse/-/issues/1): Chamber mapping fixes
- [Bitbucket Issue OD-101](https://bitbucket.org/cbwinslow/opendiscourse-core/issues/101): Foreign key constraint resolution
- [Jira Story OD-101](https://opendiscourse.atlassian.net/browse/OD-101): Fix Congress Bills chamber mapping

**OpenStates Integration**

- [Linear Task OST-102](https://linear.app/opendiscourse/task/OST-102): Implement missing methods

- [Bitbucket Issue OD-102](https://bitbucket.org/cbwinslow/opendiscourse-core/issues/102): Enhanced OpenStates methods
- [Jira Story OD-102](https://opendiscourse.atlassian.net/browse/OD-102): OpenStates ingestion implementation

**GovInfo Processing**

- [Linear Task GOV-103](https://linear.app/opendiscourse/task/GOV-103): Monitoring system enhancement

### 📊 Processing & Analytics

**Database Optimization**

- [Linear Task DB-104](https://linear.app/opendiscourse/task/DB-104): Database standards compliance
- [GitLab Issue #4](https://gitlab.com/cbwinslow/opendiscourse/-/issues/4): Database connection standards
- [Bitbucket Issue OD-104](https://bitbucket.org/cbwinslow/opendiscourse-core/issues/104): Database optimization
- [Jira Story OD-104](https://opendiscourse.atlassian.net/browse/OD-104): Database standards violations

### 🔍 Semantic Search (Project v2)

**PGVector Integration**
- [GitHub Issue #6](https://github.com/cbwinslow/opendiscourse/issues/6): PGVector integration
- [Linear Task PG-201](https://linear.app/opendiscourse/task/PG-201): Semantic search foundation
- [GitLab Epic ODV2-5](https://gitlab.com/cbwinslow/opendiscourse-v2/-/epics/5): PGVector Semantic Search
- [Bitbucket Issue ODV2-201](https://bitbucket.org/cbwinslow/opendiscourse-v2/issues/201): PGVector integration
- [Jira Epic ODV2-1](https://opendiscourse.atlassian.net/browse/ODV2-1): PGVector Semantic Search Foundation

**Historical Data Expansion**
- [GitHub Issue #7](https://github.com/cbwinslow/opendiscourse/issues/7): Historical Congress data
- [Linear Task HIST-202](https://linear.app/opendiscourse/task/HIST-202): Historical data archive
- [GitLab Epic ODV2-6](https://gitlab.com/cbwinslow/opendiscourse-v2/-/epics/6): Historical Congress Data
- [Bitbucket Issue ODV2-202](https://bitbucket.org/cbwinslow/opendiscourse-v2/issues/202): Historical data expansion
- [Jira Epic ODV2-2](https://opendiscourse.atlassian.net/browse/ODV2-2): Historical Congress Data Archive

## Current Development Status

### Sprint 1: Critical Bug Fixes (In Progress)
- **GitHub Projects**: [OpenDiscourse Core Platform](https://github.com/cbwinslow/opendiscourse/projects/1)
- **Linear Sprints**: [Sprint 1 - Critical Bug Fixes](https://linear.app/opendiscourse/sprint/2025-12-01)
- **GitLab Milestones**: [v1.2.0 - Critical Bug Fixes](https://gitlab.com/cbwinslow/opendiscourse/-/milestones/1)
- **Jira Board**: [OpenDiscourse Core Scrum](https://opendiscourse.atlassian.net/boards/1)

### Sprint 2: System Stabilization (Planned)
- **Timeline**: December 16-30, 2025
- **Focus**: Monitoring improvements and database optimization
- **GitHub Milestone**: [v1.3.0 - System Improvements](https://github.com/cbwinslow/opendiscourse/milestone/2)
- **Linear Sprint**: [Sprint 2 - System Stabilization](https://linear.app/opendiscourse/sprint/2025-12-16)

### Sprint 3: PGVector Foundation (Planned)
- **Timeline**: January 1-15, 2026
- **Focus**: Beginning Project v2 implementation
- **GitHub Project**: [Project v2 - Semantic Search](https://github.com/cbwinslow/opendiscourse/projects/2)
- **Jira Board**: [Project v2 Kanban](https://opendiscourse.atlassian.net/boards/2)

## Architecture Decisions

### Why Multiple Platforms?

We utilize multiple project management platforms to leverage their respective strengths:

- **GitHub**: Code-centric development, CI/CD, and issue tracking
- **Linear**: Agile planning and team collaboration
- **GitLab**: Epic management and milestone tracking
- **Bitbucket**: Pipeline automation and code quality
- **Jira**: Enterprise-grade agile development
- **Confluence**: Knowledge management and documentation

### Integration Strategy

All platforms maintain real-time synchronization through our integration engine, ensuring:
- Single source of truth for critical data
- Consistent status across all platforms
- Automated reporting and analytics
- Streamlined team communication

pages.title: Platform Integration Guide
pages.content:
# Cross-Platform Integration Guide

## Overview

The OpenDiscourse project leverages multiple project management platforms to optimize workflow efficiency while maintaining data consistency and real-time synchronization across all systems.

## Platform Strategy

### Why Multiple Platforms?

Each platform serves specific strengths:

- **GitHub**: Code-centric development, Git workflow, CI/CD integration
- **Linear**: Agile planning, team collaboration, visual workflow
- **GitLab**: Epic management, milestone tracking, DevOps integration
- **Bitbucket**: Pipeline automation, code quality, Atlassian ecosystem
- **Jira**: Enterprise agile development, advanced reporting, compliance
- **Confluence**: Knowledge management, technical documentation

## Integration Architecture

### Real-Time Synchronization

```mermaid
graph LR
    A[GitHub Issues] <--> B[Integration Hub]
    C[Linear Tasks] <--> B
    D[GitLab Issues] <--> B
    E[Bitbucket Issues] <--> B
    F[Jira Tickets] <--> B
    B <--> G[Confluence Updates]
    B <--> H[Webhook Triggers]
    B <--> I[API Gateway]
```

### Data Flow

1. **Issue Creation**: Any platform can create issues that propagate to others
2. **Status Updates**: Status changes synchronize across all platforms
3. **Label Standardization**: Consistent labeling across all systems
4. **Assignment Coordination**: Assignee information syncs in real-time
5. **Progress Tracking**: Unified progress reporting and analytics

## Implementation Details

### GitHub Integration

**Webhook Configuration**
```json
{
  "url": "https://api.opendiscourse.com/webhooks/github",
  "events": [
    "issues.opened",
    "issues.edited", 
    "issues.closed",
    "issues.labeled",
    "pull_request.opened",
    "pull_request.closed"
  ]
}
```

**Issue Mapping**
```python
github_issue_mapping = {
    'github_id': 'id',
    'title': 'title',
    'description': 'body',
    'status': 'state',
    'labels': 'labels[].name',
    'assignee': 'assignee.login',
    'created_at': 'created_at',
    'updated_at': 'updated_at'
}
```

### Linear Integration

**API Configuration**
```javascript
const linearConfig = {
  apiKey: process.env.LINEAR_API_KEY,
  teamId: 'opendiscourse-core',
  webhookUrl: 'https://api.opendiscourse.com/webhooks/linear'
};
```

**Task Synchronization**
```javascript
// Sync Linear task to other platforms
const syncLinearTask = async (task) => {
  const taskData = {
    linear_id: task.id,
    title: task.title,
    description: task.description,
    priority: mapLinearPriority(task.priority),
    assignee: task.assignee?.name,
    labels: task.labels?.map(l => l.name),
    created_at: task.createdAt
  };
  
  await Promise.all([
    createGitHubIssue(taskData),
    createGitLabIssue(taskData),
    createBitbucketIssue(taskData),
    createJiraTicket(taskData)
  ]);
};
```

### GitLab Integration

**Epic Synchronization**
```python
gitlab_epic_mapping = {
    'epic_id': 'iid',
    'title': 'title',
    'description': 'description', 
    'start_date': 'start_date',
    'end_date': 'due_date',
    'status': 'state',
    'labels': 'labels',
    'author': 'author.username'
}
```

### Bitbucket Integration

**Pipeline Triggers**
```yaml
pipelines:
  default:
    - step:
        name: Sync Issue Status
        image: atlassian/default-image:3
        script:
          - python scripts/sync_issue_status.py
          - python scripts/update_confluence_page.py
```

### Jira Integration

**Webhook Configuration**
```json
{
  "jql": "project = OD AND statusCategory != Done",
  "events": [
    "jira:issue_created",
    "jira:issue_updated",
    "jira:issue_deleted"
  ],
  "webhookUrl": "https://api.opendiscourse.com/webhooks/jira"
}
```

## Automation Scripts

### Cross-Platform Issue Creation

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Cross-Platform Issue Synchronization Script
Creates issues across all platforms with consistent data
"""

import asyncio
import logging
from typing import Dict, List
from github import GitHubAPI
from linear import LinearAPI  
from gitlab import GitLabAPI
from bitbucket import BitbucketAPI
from jira import JiraAPI

class CrossPlatformSync:
    def __init__(self):
        self.github = GitHubAPI()
        self.linear = LinearAPI()
        self.gitlab = GitLabAPI()
        self.bitbucket = BitbucketAPI()
        self.jira = JiraAPI()
        
    async def create_issue_across_platforms(self, issue_data: Dict) -> Dict:
        """Create issue across all platforms"""
        
        # Standardize issue data
        standardized_data = self.standardize_issue_data(issue_data)
        
        # Create on all platforms concurrently
        results = await asyncio.gather(
            self.github.create_issue(standardized_data),
            self.linear.create_task(standardized_data),
            self.gitlab.create_issue(standardized_data),
            self.bitbucket.create_issue(standardized_data),
            self.jira.create_ticket(standardized_data)
        )
        
        # Update Confluence with issue references
        await self.update_confluence_page(standardized_data, results)
        
        return {
            'github_id': results[0]['id'],
            'linear_id': results[1]['id'],
            'gitlab_iid': results[2]['iid'],
            'bitbucket_id': results[3]['id'],
            'jira_key': results[4]['key']
        }
    
    async def sync_status_update(self, platform: str, issue_id: str, new_status: str):
        """Synchronize status updates across all platforms"""
        
        # Map status to platform-specific values
        status_mapping = self.map_status_across_platforms(new_status)
        
        # Update status on all platforms
        await asyncio.gather(
            self.github.update_issue_status(issue_id, status_mapping['github']),
            self.linear.update_task_status(issue_id, status_mapping['linear']),
            self.gitlab.update_issue_status(issue_id, status_mapping['gitlab']),
            self.bitbucket.update_issue_status(issue_id, status_mapping['bitbucket']),
            self.jira.update_ticket_status(issue_id, status_mapping['jira'])
        )
```

### Progress Tracking Automation

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Automated Progress Tracking and Reporting
Generates comprehensive progress reports across all platforms
"""

import json
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from typing import Dict, List

class ProgressTracker:
    def __init__(self):
        self.platforms = {
            'github': GitHubAPI(),
            'linear': LinearAPI(),
            'gitlab': GitLabAPI(),
            'bitbucket': BitbucketAPI(),
            'jira': JiraAPI()
        }
        
    async def generate_daily_report(self) -> Dict:
        """Generate daily progress report across all platforms"""
        
        report = {
            'date': datetime.now().isoformat(),
            'platforms': {},
            'sprint_progress': {},
            'critical_issues': [],
            'velocity_metrics': {},
            'blockers': []
        }
        
        # Collect data from all platforms
        for platform_name, api in self.platforms.items():
            platform_data = await self.collect_platform_data(api)
            report['platforms'][platform_name] = platform_data
        
        # Update Confluence dashboard
        await self.update_dashboard_page(report)
        
        # Send notifications for critical updates
        await self.send_critical_notifications(report)
        
        return report
    
    async def generate_sprint_report(self, sprint_id: str) -> Dict:
        """Generate comprehensive sprint report"""
        
        sprint_report = {
            'sprint_id': sprint_id,
            'generated_at': datetime.now().isoformat(),
            'summary': await self.calculate_sprint_summary(sprint_id),
            'velocity': await self.calculate_velocity_metrics(sprint_id),
            'burndown': await self.generate_burndown_chart(sprint_id),
            'risk_assessment': await self.assess_sprint_risks(sprint_id),
            'recommendations': await self.generate_recommendations(sprint_id)
        }
        
        # Save to Confluence
        await self.save_sprint_report(sprint_report)
        
        return sprint_report
```

## Monitoring and Alerting

### Health Check Endpoints

```python
from fastapi import FastAPI
from pydantic import BaseModel

app = FastAPI()

class HealthCheck(BaseModel):
    status: str
    platforms: Dict[str, bool]
    last_sync: str
    error_count: int

@app.get("/health", response_model=HealthCheck)
async def health_check():
    """Health check endpoint for integration status"""
    
    platform_status = {}
    for name, api in self.platforms.items():
        try:
            await api.health_check()
            platform_status[name] = True
        except Exception as e:
            platform_status[name] = False
            logging.error(f"Platform {name} health check failed: {e}")
    
    return HealthCheck(
        status="healthy" if all(platform_status.values()) else "degraded",
        platforms=platform_status,
        last_sync=datetime.now().isoformat(),
        error_count=self.error_counter
    )
```

## Performance Optimization

### Caching Strategy

```python
from functools import lru_cache
import redis

class CachedPlatformAPI:
    def __init__(self):
        self.redis_client = redis.Redis()
        
    @lru_cache(maxsize=1000)
    async def get_issue_cached(self, issue_id: str) -> Dict:
        """Cache frequently accessed issues"""
        cached = self.redis_client.get(f"issue:{issue_id}")
        if cached:
            return json.loads(cached)
        
        issue = await self.get_issue_raw(issue_id)
        self.redis_client.setex(
            f"issue:{issue_id}", 
            3600,  # 1 hour cache
            json.dumps(issue)
        )
        return issue
```
